size_note: 123 x 43 x 20 mm (GSMArena, devicebeast); gsmchoice's 141 mm includes the antenna. A photo of the J6 beside the J5 (1gr.cz, via Koks) shows them the same length and the J6 98% as wide at its widest (the display); with the J5 at 123 x 45 that is 122 x 44, and the museum's straight-on shot has the same proportions (2.77). The antenna stands 16 mm above the body (layout_mm.parts). No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD window measures about 30 x 29 mm; 1.55in at the native 96 x 92

screen.note: w/h from the diagonal at the native aspect, x centred; y = top edge, measured on the geometry photo

key_icons: Oval dark keys in three columns, each digit large with its small letters to its right. The 1 key also shows a small voicemail icon (two rings joined along their bottoms); the 0 key shows a space symbol and '+'; the # key shows '@'; the * key shows only its symbol.
keypad_labels: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PQRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXYZ

geometry_photo.note: photo of the J5 and J6 side by side (via Koks); the image is squeezed sideways, stretched back by 1.078 so the J5 matches its 123 x 45 mm

screen.note: screen hole in skin.png (12 px/mm, 1 mm padding); exact native aspect
